steps: kubectl create namespace fixture-helm-list and fixture-helm-list-data

install with harness helm, every release labelled dockflow.shawiizz.dev/stack=fixture-helm-list and dockflow.shawiizz.dev/role=<role>: data (e2e-pvc 0.1.0, accessory, namespace fixture-helm-list-data); search (e2e-web, app, four revisions ending on 0.2.0 with values message and replicaCount, revision 4 re-applying the spec of revision 2); cache (e2e-web 0.1.0 then an upgrade to e2e-broken 0.1.0 with --wait --timeout 60s, left failed); queue (e2e-web 0.1.0, accessory, install killed with SIGKILL during --wait, left pending-install); reports (e2e-web, app, upgrade killed during --wait, left pending-upgrade); archive (e2e-web 0.1.0, accessory, then helm uninstall --keep-history)
list-default.json: helm list -A -l dockflow.shawiizz.dev/stack=fixture-helm-list -o json (no -a: only deployed and failed releases)
values-search.json: helm get values search -n fixture-helm-list -o json
values-data.json: helm get values data -n fixture-helm-list-data -o json (installed without values)
manifest-search.yaml: helm get manifest search -n fixture-helm-list
manifest-data.yaml: helm get manifest data -n fixture-helm-list-data
release-secrets.txt: kubectl get secrets -n fixture-helm-list -l "owner=helm,name=search,status in (deployed,superseded),dockflow.shawiizz.dev/spec-hash=bd40bee78a12f71d77653d3178f8a4ab" -o name
